name: workspace-desktop
description: WayNoted — local workspace for macOS and Windows

scripts.dev: npm run build:agent && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "vite" "wait-on tcp:5310 && node scripts/run-electron.mjs --dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:agent && node scripts/run-electron.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run configure && npm run build && npm run build:native && npm run build:agent && node build/package.mjs
scripts.dist:test: npm run configure && npm run build && npm run build:native && npm run build:agent && node build/package.mjs --test
scripts.dist:win: npm run configure && npm run build && node build/build-windows-native.mjs --arch=x64 && npm run build:agent && node build/package.mjs --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run configure && npm run build && node build/build-windows-native.mjs --arch=arm64 && npm run build:agent && node build/package.mjs --platform=win32 --arch=arm64
